title.narrative: Adaptation planning Serbia NAP-UNDP-SRB-00106706

description.narrative: Advancing medium and long-term adaptation planning in the Republic of Serbia (GCF Readiness Programme). The overall goal of NAP is to reduce climate change related risks throughout Serbia by strengthening institutional and technical capacities that support integrated CCA planning and programming.

comment.narrative: 1. NAP identified as NDC commitment; Weak NCCC mandate for CCA. 2. Data is fragmented, incomplete, and is not readily accessible. 3. Climate adaptation not well understood by all relevant national and subnational stakeholders; Technical knowledge and skill gaps detrimental to CCA. 4. CCA is not well understood; Trainings are static and not ongoing. 5. No NAP; CCA mentioned in few ministry policies on ad hoc basis; Little integration into local planning documents. 6. Low general and sectorial awareness of CCA.

1. NCCC mission updated to include CCA 2.
